featured_reviews.name: Riya Sharma
featured_reviews.review_text:
One of the Worst Gym Experiences – Not Worth Your Time or Money

I rarely leave negative reviews, but after months of giving Flex Gym the benefit of the doubt, I feel compelled to share my experience so others don’t waste their time like I did.

First of all, the facility maintenance is pathetic. There’s been a persistent water leakage issue in multiple areas of the gym, especially around the ceiling and changing rooms. It’s not only inconvenient but straight-up dangerous—I've seen people slip, and the staff just casually mop it up without addressing the root problem. The smell of dampness in certain corners is unbearable, and it’s clear management has no intention of fixing it any time soon.

Secondly, the gym is overcrowded at nearly all hours, making it impossible to get a proper workout in. Whether you go in the morning, afternoon, or evening, you’ll find long queues for basic equipment, weights scattered everywhere, and zero enforcement of discipline on the floor. Members do whatever they want—hogging equipment, dropping weights, playing loud music—and no one steps in to manage the chaos.

The trainers are hardly any help either. Most of them are either busy chatting with their friends or paying attention only to their personal training clients. One staff member, Shweta, in particular, has been repeatedly rude and unapproachable. Instead of helping members or maintaining order, she seems more interested in power-tripping or gossiping at the front desk.

To make matters worse, the owner Brajesh Gupta is completely uninvolved. He clearly doesn’t care about the gym’s condition or member experience—there’s no quality control, no feedback mechanism, and no visible effort to improve anything. It honestly feels like they’re just there to collect fees without offering any value in return.

There’s no cap on memberships, so the place is packed beyond capacity every day. Even during "off-peak" hours, there’s barely enough space to move, let alone train effectively.

Save yourself the frustration. There are far better gyms out there that actually invest in their infrastructure, enforce discipline, and treat members with respect. Until Flex Gym sorts out its serious hygiene, management, and behavioral issues, I’d strongly recommend staying away.

featured_reviews.name: Komal Auti
featured_reviews.review_text:
I am a second-year engineering student, and my journey at the IGNITE Event Fashion Show was truly one of the most memorable experiences of my college life.
During the IGNITE event organized by our college, a fashion show was arranged, and I got the opportunity to participate in it. For our choreography, Kristina Ma’am and Pushpen Sir were appointed as our mentors. From 21st January to 31st January, we trained under their guidance, and the experience of working with them was absolutely fabulous. It was my first time participating in such a grand event, and throughout the journey, I felt myself growing more confident day by day.
Day 1
On the very first day, I had no prior experience and no clear idea about choreography or stage performance. However, once the practice began, Kristina Ma’am made everything feel comfortable. Slowly and steadily, she helped us build confidence. She is extremely calm, patient, and supportive. Even when we made mistakes repeatedly, she never scolded us. Instead, she focused on correcting us and teaching us again with the same dedication and positivity.
Day 2
On the second day, Ma’am helped everyone with costume practice as well. The practice sessions were continuous and intense, but neither Ma’am nor Sir ever showed tiredness. They practiced with us, put in equal effort, and stayed till late hours. Even while returning home late at night, they remained energetic and motivating, which inspired us even more.
Day 3
On the third day, I personally faced a bit of weakness and low confidence. Because of that, I sometimes forgot steps during practice. Kristina Ma’am noticed this and personally asked me if I was facing any problem. She encouraged me to share openly and assured me that we would work through it together. That support meant a lot to me. With every passing day, my confidence kept increasing. We practiced continuously for 4–5 hours, and since Ma’am and Sir practiced alongside us, the entire process felt enjoyable and motivating.
Day 4 & Day 5
During the last two days, several complications and challenges came up. However, Kristina Ma’am handled every situation very smartly and calmly. She encouraged us to stay focused and give our best despite the difficulties. Her motivation pushed us to practice with even more dedication and energy.
Day 6 – Final Day
The final day was truly the best and most exciting day. After so many days of hard work, our efforts were finally going to show results. Ma’am helped us with costumes, makeup, and overall presentation. Even when some costumes were not ready on time, she managed everything perfectly.
The most amazing part of the performance was the final dance, where we performed together with Sir and Ma’am. The performance was powerful, energetic, and truly a stage-breaking one. The result we had worked so hard for came out exactly the way we hoped.

This entire journey with the Dance and Fitness Team was more than just a performance—it was a lesson in confidence, discipline, teamwork, and dedication. I am extremely grateful to Kristina Ma’am and Pushpen Sir for their guidance, patience, and constant support.
This experience will always hold a special place in my heart and will remain one of the best memories of my college life.

-komal auti
Smt indira gandhi college of engineering
Se mechanical

I have been a regular member of Grace Gym for the past one year and had also taken personal training (PT) membership. The gym fees and PT charges are reasonable, which is why many people join this gym.

When questioned, the manager simply states that the gym was never promised as an air-conditioned facility.

The equipment is also poorly maintained. The treadmills are outdated and often stop abruptly while in use, which can be unsafe. There is no proper music system, and members have to repeatedly remind the trainers to switch it on.

Another major issue is the lack of adequate trainers. There is only one dedicated trainer in the morning and evening, who simultaneously handles multiple personal training clients. There is no general trainer available on the gym floor. PT sessions are conducted with multiple clients at the same time, defeating the purpose of personal training.

The management seems efficient only when it comes to collecting money, but completely indifferent when members raise genuine concerns. Despite multiple complaints, no corrective action is taken. Ironically, when payments are due, the manager named Yash is extremely persistent, calling and messaging repeatedly, which feels harassing.

Overall, I would not recommend this gym unless the management takes serious steps to renovate the facility, maintain equipment properly, ensure basic amenities, and hire sufficient trainers.

featured_reviews.name: Annie DCosta
featured_reviews.review_text:
I joined this Gym in March with high hopes for a positive fitness journey. Unfortunately, my experience has been marred by a series of disappointments, ultimately leading me to question the professionalism of the establishment.

My initial encounter with the first trainer turned out to be a costly mistake, as he proved to be a con man who cheated me out of 9k. The second trainer, while competent, left due to personal issues, leaving me with an abrupt disruption in my training routine.

The management's response to these setbacks was far from satisfactory. The third trainer they assigned to me consistently displayed a lack of respect for time, consistently arriving late by 30 minutes or, at times, not showing up at all. This disregard for punctuality not only reflected poorly on the trainer but also raised concerns about the gym's commitment to delivering quality services.

Despite these issues, the management, rather audaciously, arranged for a fourth trainer. This constant turnover of trainers further highlighted a lack of stability and professionalism within the gym's staff.

As a paying member committed until December, with an annual membership in place, I am disheartened by the overall experience. In hindsight, my initial enthusiasm led me to inaccurately rate the gym with 5 stars. It is evident that THIS gym is in dire need of a more professional approach to its hiring and management practices to provide a consistent and reliable service to its members.
